stem: A light horizontal rod $\overline{AD}$ has points $A, B, C, D$ in order from left to right, where $AB = 30\text{ cm}$, $BC = 20\text{ cm}$, and $CD = 50\text{ cm}$. Three vertical forces act on the rod: $15\text{ N}$ downwards at $A$, $25\text{ N}$ upwards at $B$, and $6\text{ N}$ downwards at $D$.
